modules.name: projectScanner
modules.responsibility: Scan file tree and detect stack, tags, and real entry points

modules.name: architectureAnalyzer
modules.responsibility: Analyze architecture layers, infer flows, detect dependencies and structural bottlenecks

modules.name: contextBuilder
modules.responsibility: Build system summary, main flows, and critical points from architecture and diagnostics

modules.name: tokenizer
modules.responsibility: Generate project knowledge tokens with importance and confidence

modules.name: diagnosticEngine

modules.responsibility: Compare current and previous token states and emit changes/improvements

modules.name: guidanceEngine
modules.responsibility: Generate prioritized next steps, fixes and optimizations

modules.name: intelligenceLayer
modules.responsibility: Orchestrate full analysis pipeline, keep runtime compatibility, and persist analysis artifacts
